|game_text='''0 side — This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time'''

Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders, Endor Shield, [Death Star II] Executor, or [Episode I] (or [Episode VII]) cards with ability. During your deploy phase, your Lando may make a regular move. While this side up, opponent loses no Force to Cloud City Occupation or your Force drains at Bespin system. Once during your turn, may ▲ Dark Deal or [Special Edition] Bespin. Flip this card if you control three Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than three Bespin locations.

'''7 side — Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further'''

While this side up, Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and Alter may not be played. While your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.
|errata_history=The September 2026 errata mark is E2 on both faces. The 0 side extends the deployment restrictions, moves Lando’s movement to the deploy phase, prevents Force loss from [[Cloud City Occupation]] and Force drains at [[Bespin]], and removes the download for [[Vader's Bounty]]. The 7 side ties the ban on [[Alter]] to [[Darth Vader|Vader]] and limits Lando’s modifier to subtracting from an opponent’s destiny draw.
